AccessToken.description:
Access token response schema.

Represents the access token issued after successful authentication.

Attributes
----------
access_token : str
    JWT access token used for authenticated requests.
access_token_expiry : datetime
    Expiration timestamp of the access token (UTC).
token_type : str
    Token scheme used for authentication (e.g., "bearer").
AccessToken.title: AccessToken

ForgotPasswordRequest.description:
Schema for forgot password request.

Represents the payload required to initiate a password reset process.

Attributes
----------
email : str
    The email address of the user requesting a password reset.
ForgotPasswordRequest.title: ForgotPasswordRequest

ManagerCreateRequest.description:
Payload for creating a MANAGER user.

`organization_guid` is forwarded to the Booking Service in the
user-created event, which maps the new manager to that organization.
Auth does not validate it because it holds no organization data.
ManagerCreateRequest.title: ManagerCreateRequest

RefreshTokenRequest.description:
Refresh token request schema.

Represents the payload required to refresh an access token using a valid refresh token.

Attributes
----------
refresh_token : str
    The JWT refresh token used to obtain a new access token.
RefreshTokenRequest.title: RefreshTokenRequest

ResetPasswordRequest.description:
Schema for reset password request.

Represents the payload required to complete a password reset process.

Attributes
----------
token : str
    The password reset token sent to the user's email.
new_password : str
    The new password that the user wants to set.
ResetPasswordRequest.title: ResetPasswordRequest

Token.description:
Authentication token response schema.

Represents the access token issued after successful authentication.

Attributes
----------
access_token : str
    JWT access token used for authenticated requests (from parent class AccessToken).
access_token_expiry : datetime
    Expiration timestamp of the access token (UTC) (from parent class AccessToken).
refresh_token : str
    JWT refresh token used to obtain new access tokens after expiration.
refresh_token_expiry : datetime
    Expiration timestamp of the refresh token (UTC).
token_type : str
    Token scheme used for authentication (e.g., "bearer") (from parent class AccessToken).
Token.title: Token

UserCreateRequest.description:
Payload for creating a user by an authorized admin/owner/manager.

Password is generated by the backend and delivered via welcome email.
UserCreateRequest.title: UserCreateRequest

UserType.description:
User role types for role-based access control (RBAC).

This enum defines user permission levels in the system hierarchy.
Values are stored as integers in the database for efficiency.

Attributes
----------
ADMIN : int
    System administrator with full access to all features and settings.
    Can manage all users, content, and system configurations.
    Value: 1
OWNER : int
    Business or organization owner with elevated privileges. Can manage
    organizational settings and create users under organization.
    Value: 2
MANAGER : int
    Manager role with permissions to oversee specific areas or teams.
    Can manage customers and content within their assigned scope.
    Value: 3
CUSTOMER : int
    End user or client with standard access to services and features.
    Value: 4
INTERNALE : int
    Reserved role for authenticated internal API callers. This role must
    not be exposed through public user creation or public API access.
    Value: 5
UserType.title: UserType

UserUpdateRequest.description:
Payload for updating a provisioned user by an authorized actor.

GUID identifies the target user and is sent in the body, not the URL.

post.description:
Handle user requests for password reset.

This endpoint initiates the password reset process by accepting a user's
email address or username. It verifies the existence of the user and,
if found, triggers the sending of a password reset email containing a
secure, time-limited token. This allows users to securely reset their
passwords without exposing sensitive information.

schema.title: Response Forgot Password Api V1 Login Forgot Password Post

post.description:
Refresh an expired access token using a valid refresh token.

Validates the provided JWT refresh token and, if valid, issues a new
JWT access token with updated expiration. Claims are built from the
user's current state, so role or email verification changes apply on
the next refresh. Missing, deleted or inactive users are rejected.

example.message: You are not authorized to perform this action. Please authenticate and try again.

401.description: Authentication failed or user is not authorized to access this resource.

post.description:
Handle user requests to reset their password.

This endpoint accepts a secure token and a new password. It validates the
token to ensure it is valid, not expired, and has not been used. If the
token is valid, the user's password is updated to the new password, and
the token is marked as used to prevent reuse. This allows users to securely
reset their passwords while ensuring that tokens cannot be exploited.

schema.title: Response Reset Password Api V1 Login Reset Password Post
